;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Afghan peace process]]
**The [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] urges the [[Taliban]] to extend the three-day [[truce]] due to expire today. It also announces the government will release 900 Taliban prisoners today. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban-ceasefire/afghan-government-will-free-900-taliban-prisoners-tuesday-afghan-official-idUSKBN23216O (Reuters)]
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[Libya–Russia relations]]
**The [[United States Africa Command]] accuses [[Russia]] of deploying fighter jets to eastern [[Libya]] to provide [[air support]] to [[Wagner Group|Russian mercenaries]] allied to [[Field marshal (Libya)|Field Marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]], who is locked in a [[civil war]] with the [[United Nations|UN]]-recognized [[Government of National Accord]] (GNA). [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52811093 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo massacres]]
**The [[Allied Democratic Forces]] [[massacre|kill at least 17 people]] in a village in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], one of three [[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency|massacres by the ADF]] this week. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-congo-security/suspected-islamist-militia-kills-at-least-17-in-northeastern-congo-idUKKBN23238D?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[ISWAP]] militants kill two [[Cameroon Armed Forces|soldiers]] and wound five others in Soueram, [[Far North Region, Cameroon|Far North]], [[Cameroon]]. Five militants also die in the attack. [https://actucameroun.com/2020/05/26/cameroun-deux-soldats-et-5-assaillants-tues-dans-une-attaque-djihadiste-a-soueram/amp/ (Actu Cameroun)]

;Business and economy
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]], [[Coronavirus recession]]
**[[LATAM Airlines Group|LATAM Airlines]], the largest air carrier in [[Latin America]], files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-05-26/latam-airlines-files-chapter-11-bankruptcy-stymied-by-lockdowns (Bloomberg)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Huge swarms of desert [[locust]]s destroy crops in central and western [[India]] prompting authorities to step up their response to the country's worst [[Swarm behaviour | plague]] in nearly three decades. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/crops-destroyed-india-faces-worst-locust-attack-27-years-200526160727430.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[LGBT rights in Costa Rica]]
**[[Costa Rica]] becomes the first [[Central America]]n country to legalize [[Same-sex marriage in Costa Rica|same-sex marriage]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-costarica-lgbt-marriage-trfn/costa-rica-allows-same-sex-marriages-in-a-first-for-central-america-idUSKBN23217L (Reuters)]
*[[LGBT rights in Zambia]]
**[[President of Zambia|President]] [[Edgar Lungu]] pardons a [[gay couple]] jailed for 15 years due to consensual [[homosexual acts]] amid a mass wave of pardons of nearly 3,000 inmates to celebrate [[Africa Day|Africa Freedom Day]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zambia-lgbt/zambian-president-pardons-gay-couple-jailed-for-15-years-idUSKBN2321ZZ (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*The [[Social Democratic Liberal Party]], the main opposition party in [[Fiji]]'s [[Parliament of Fiji|parliament]], is suspended from parliament for 60 days amid a political feud which has caused its appointments to be declared null and void. The party's parliament leader, [[Sitiveni Rabuka]], said the decision will not be appealed. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/417605/fiji-s-main-opposition-party-suspended-from-parliament (RNZ)]
